# Foundation models by institution, company, or university

[简体中文](../../../foundation-models/catalog/by-organization.md) · English

Grouped by the first listed affiliation of the first author, newest first within each group. Joint work appears only under that affiliation.

## Ai2

- 2026-08-10 · [Cracks in the Foundation: Seemingly Minor Architectural Choices Impact Long Context Extension](../../../reproductions/2608.10296-olmpool-long-context/README-en.md) (`olmpool-long-context`): Use a controlled 7B model pool to isolate compound effects of normalization, GQA, pretraining length, and sliding-window attention on long-context extension.

## Apple

- 2026-10-09 · [On the Design Space of Continuous Diffusion Language Models](../../../reproductions/2610.13834-doublecat-semicat/README-en.md) (`doublecat-semicat`): High-dimensional Gaussian noise has norm about $\sqrt{|V|}$, while the one-hot signal has norm 1. Existing tokens can therefore be hard to identify.
- 2026-09-29 · [On Trajectory-Aware Training for Masked Diffusion Language Models](../../../foundation-models/2609.37974-pumba/README-en.md) (`pumba`): During training, unroll consecutive denoising steps along the model's own progressive-unmasking trajectory. Pass a hidden carry to the next step and backpropagate through time within a fixed window, so an earlier step learns to produce a useful carry for later steps.

## Arizona State University

- 2026-10-15 · [EgoP²C: Internalizing Plan-Perceive-Compose for Spatial Reasoning in Egocentric Video](../../../foundation-models/2610.22681-ego-p2c/README-en.md) (`ego-p2c`): EgoP²C first trains separate plan/compose (PC) and perception (V) LoRA teachers on a frozen VLM. It copies selected FFNs into PC, V, and general direct-answer (G) experts. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## Australian Institute for Machine Learning, Adelaide University

- 2026-10-22 · [Inside-JEPA: From Prediction to Relational Grounding in Latent World Models](../../../foundation-models/2610.31194-inside-jepa/README-en.md) (`inside-jepa`): Entity latents are width 32, ordered-pair channels eight or sixteen. Four slots, padded and diagonal terms fixed at zero, give 256 dimensions for eight channels, not 224. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.** [Method reference 1](<https://arxiv.org/html/2610.31194v1#S3>)

## Authors did not disclose affiliation

- 2026-07-31 · [TransMem: Transforming Hidden States into Memory for Large Language Models](../../../reproductions/2607.29032-transmem/README-en.md) (`transmem`): Convert sparse historical hidden states from a frozen backbone to reusable parametric memory. Learn a gate by evidence-conditioned self-distillation.

## Bar-Ilan University

- 2026-09-29 · [Cross-Entropy Guided Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models](../../../foundation-models/2609.37751-ce-guided-moe/README-en.md) (`ce-guided-moe`): Use a shifted logarithm of predicted error to attenuate routing logits before Top-K, downweighting experts with high predicted error. Actual next-token cross-entropy supervises the error head.

## Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

- 2026-09-03 · [Lngram v2: Latent N-Gram Memory with Interpretable Discrete Representations](../../../reproductions/2609.03426-lngram-v2/README-en.md) (`lngram-v2`): Grouped-query attention reads multiple route tokens back into the backbone. Hard addresses are interpretable, neighboring counterfactual addresses provide gradients, and a zero sink allows the model to ignore unhelpful memory.

## Boston University

- 2026-10-27 · [SWIM: Learning What Matters from Behaviors for JEPA World Models](../../../foundation-models/2610.36662-swim/README-en.md) (`swim`): Stage 1 gates **only the future displacement**, leaving the entire current state visible. Stage 2 scales previously standardized states by the square root of the frozen weights and matches latent and state distances for the same frame pairs. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## ByteDance

- 2026-08-12 · [Generation as Auxiliary Supervision: Enhancing Visual Understanding at Zero Inference Overhead via Decoupled Embedding Prediction](../../../reproductions/2608.12209-gas/README-en.md) (`gas`): Generation gradients improve shared visual features without directly changing the understanding-only upper layers. Generation can be removed entirely at deployment.

## ByteDance Seed

- 2026-10-08 · [Few-Step Generation via Data-Space Iteration](../../../foundation-models/2610.12102-data-space-iteration/README-en.md) (`data-space-iteration`): Prefix rollouts do not build a gradient graph. Method and appendix [Method reference 1](<https://arxiv.org/html/2610.12102v1#S2>)

## Carnegie Mellon University

- 2023-12-01 · [Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces](../../../reproductions/2312.00752-mamba/README-en.md) (`mamba`): Mamba makes the SSM step size and read/write vectors depend on the current token. This selectively retains information while keeping computation linear in sequence length.

## Columbia University

- 2025-07-31 · [Model Directions, Not Words: Mechanistic Topic Models Using Sparse Autoencoders](../../../foundation-models/2507.23220-mechanistic-etm/README-en.md) (`mechanistic-etm`): Eqs. 16–19 use independent SAE decoder columns only for steering: combine and normalize those directions, remove the existing parallel component, then inject the specified strength. A negative control with different encoders and decoders catches implicit weight tying. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## Câmara dos Deputados

- 2026-10-16 · [Jev-as-a-Judge for Brazilian Portuguese Information Retrieval: Relevance Assessment and Reranking](../../../foundation-models/2610.23346-jev-portuguese-ir/README-en.md) (`jev-portuguese-ir`): On Quati it separately uses an independent Noul probability that each document directly answers the query, gathers every batch, and sorts the results. Candidates do not compete in a single Choice, probabilities are not mixed with BM25 scores, and there is no trained calibrator. **Evaluation protocol interface; not a model capability result.**

## Dalian Maritime University

- 2026-10-08 · [Specialized Decision Models vs. General-Purpose LLMs: Benchmarking Jev Across Knowledge, Reasoning, and Multilingual Tasks](../../../system-one/2610.11978-jev-capability/README-en.md) (`jev-capability`): Math is weaker than knowledge in the paper. Keep vendor-reported and author-measured scores separate because prompting protocols differ; this is not a new architecture or objective.

## DeepSeek

- 2026-01-12 · [Conditional Memory via Scalable Lookup: A New Axis of Sparsity for Large Language Models](../../../reproductions/2601.07372-engram/README-en.md) (`engram`): MoE adds conditional compute, but layers still reconstruct static local patterns. Hash normalized n-grams into a large embedding table for deterministic $O(1)$ lookup, then gate memory into early layers so attention/FFNs can focus on compositional reasoning.
- 2025-02-16 · [Native Sparse Attention: Hardware-Aligned and Natively Trainable Sparse Attention](../../../reproductions/2502.11089-native-sparse-attention/README-en.md) (`native-sparse-attention`): From pretraining onward it learns three parallel paths: compressed history blocks for global structure, query-dependent block selection for important detail, and a sliding window for recent precise information. Learned gates blend the three outputs.

## DeepSeek-AI

- 2025-12-31 · [mHC: Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections](../../../reproductions/2512.24880-mhc/README-en.md) (`mhc`): This retains cross-stream exchange while keeping each layer's residual map nonexpansive. The paper also supplies fused kernels, activation recomputation, and DualPipe overlap to control overhead.

## Dots Studio, Xiaohongshu

- 2026-10-15 · [Designing Transformers for Continuous Diffusion Language Models](../../../foundation-models/2610.22330-langdit/README-en.md) (`langdit`): LangFlow representation, cross-entropy, and sampler stay unchanged. Plaid only adopts the compatible subset; the gradient rules are not interchangeable. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## EIT-NLP

- 2026-07-30 · [WIDE: Boosting Adaptive LLM Inference via Token-level Dynamic Width Pruning](../../../reproductions/2607.28418-wide/README-en.md) (`wide`): Static pruning cannot allocate compute by token difficulty, and dynamic depth is too coarse. WIDE separately routes attention-head groups and FFN-channel groups for each token, co-designing mask reordering, block skipping, and device-side skipping.

## ETH Zurich

- 2026-10-15 · [Rethinking Routing Exploration in Modern Mixture-of-Experts](../../../foundation-models/2610.22353-mirror-moe/README-en.md) (`mirror-moe`): Rather than simply adding noise, MirrorMoE temporarily suppresses some experts through mirrored selection and anneals back to normal routing. The main source is Section 3, Eqs. 3–6. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## European Molecular Biology Laboratory (EMBL)

- 2026-10-14 · [Dataset-Level Regularization for Joint-Embedding Self-Supervised Learning](../../../reproductions/2610.20158-oob-regularization/README-en.md) (`oob-regularization`): The Gaussian variant projects onto random unit directions, sorts the examples along each direction, and matches standard-normal quantiles. The contrastive variant optimizes uniformity on the unit sphere while preserving the correspondence with each current representation. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## FAIR at Meta

- 2026-10-14 · [ESC: Escaping 2D Diffusion Ambiguity with Geometric Constraints for Consistent Novel View Synthesis](../../../foundation-models/2610.23732-esc/README-en.md) (`esc`): ESC jointly generates RGB and inverse depth, conditions Qwen MM-DiT on Plücker ray maps, and uses a bidirectional depth-reprojection constraint, PCC, to identify missing and hallucinated geometry. At inference it selects from repeated stochastic generations using PCC. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**

## FAIR, Meta

- 2026-10-14 · [Open-world AI: a Tale of Three Requirements](../../../foundation-models/2610.20782-memory-mosaics-plus/README-en.md) (`memory-mosaics-plus`): The two-stage variant estimates current and related tasks separately. A single mixed pool could make accumulating irrelevant history harmful. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## FITec Labs

- 2026-09-15 · [Persistent Recurrent Memory Between Transformer Layers Improves Language Model Generalization](../../../foundation-models/2609.17251-persistent-recurrent-memory/README-en.md) (`persistent-recurrent-memory`): Insert an observe–GRU update–gated influence state path between the lower and upper Transformer halves, so recurrent memory affects later computation.

## Fudan University

- 2026-09-29 · [Chinese-Jev: Bringing System One Model to Chinese-Language Tasks](../../../foundation-models/2609.36965-chinese-jev/README-en.md) (`chinese-jev`): Heterogeneous labels become candidate-probability distributions. Pretraining uses 10 million general examples before separate medical, legal and finance fine-tuning.
- 2026-07-27 · [DataOrchestra: Learning to Orchestrate Per-Example Curation of Pretraining Data](../../../reproductions/2607.24717-data-orchestra/README-en.md) (`data-orchestra`): A strong teacher drafts a plan. Tool models execute it and a verifier checks the result.

## Gensyn

- 2026-09-15 · [OPEN-1B: A Fully Auditable Training Run](../../../foundation-models/2609.17380-open-1b-audit/README-en.md) (`open-1b-audit`): Fix the order of kernel reductions, data batches, and collective communication. Per-step state hashes enable single-step replay audits across heterogeneous hardware.

## Google

- 2026-10-31 · [XLA from the Trenches: Correctness on TPU Workloads at Scale](../../../foundation-models/2611.00624-xla-trenches/README-en.md) (`xla-trenches`): Isolation proceeds from a large HLO graph to a fusion, then inspects intermediate VREG values without splitting the fusion. This is compiler-correctness infrastructure, not a new recommender or an industrial recommendation paper passing an A/B gate. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2026-09-25 · [Words Speak Louder Than Order: A Behavioral Evaluation of Gemma 4](../../../foundation-models/2609.30716-gemma-priority-protocol/README-en.md) (`gemma-priority-protocol`): The scope is one model, short context, and English single-word choices. This is neither a new training algorithm nor evidence about neural circuits. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-08-04 · [TaskPress: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Compression via Task-Guided Pruning](../../../foundation-models/2608.03276-taskpress/README-en.md) (`taskpress`): Lower-index tie-breaking is a local convention. The method/resources follow v2 Section 3 Eqs. 1–3; no assertion of line-by-line identity to v1. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-05-15 · [Customizing an LLM for Enterprise Software Engineering](../../../foundation-models/2605.16517-gemini-for-google/README-en.md) (`gemini-for-google`): Deduplication, quality filtering, and contamination controls produce mid-training data. General-data replay limits catastrophic forgetting, followed by post-training for internal tools and deployment evaluation.

## Google Brain

- 2021-01-11 · [Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity](../../../reproductions/2101.03961-switch-transformer/README-en.md) (`switch-transformer`): Replace dense FFNs with sparse experts. Each token activates one expert, expanding parameter capacity at approximately fixed FLOPs.

## Google Cloud

- 2026-08-06 · [Detecting Safety Training Modification in Language Models via Activation Analysis](../../../foundation-models/2608.05578-activation-model-scanner/README-en.md) (`activation-model-scanner`): This structural signal has blind spots and does not replace behavioral safety evaluation. See §IV; implementation conventions were checked against the pinned upstream `extractor.py`. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.** [Method reference 1](<https://arxiv.org/html/2608.05578v1#S4>)

## Google DeepMind

- 2026-07-23 · [Hilbert Operator for Progressive Encoding (HOPE): A Mathematical Framework for Deconstructing Learned Representations in Deep Networks](../../../foundation-models/2607.21366-hope-hilbert/README-en.md) (`hope-hilbert`): The paper uses batch-normalization statistics to constrain a Gaussian surrogate, computes a functional ReLU kernel analytically, and compares PRUNE, MERGE, and residual-block EVICT at a common distortion scale. Each greedy decision divides distortion by the **parameter savings measured on the initial model** to avoid selection bias as adjacent layers shrink. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-05-29 · [XLGoBench: Detecting cross-lingual skill gaps with algorithmic tasks](../../../foundation-models/2605.30788-xlgobench/README-en.md) (`xlgobench`): Graph-SP requires a unique shortest path, and T-Rank uses a Hamiltonian DAG with transitive edges and a 1:3 node-to-edge ratio. The local callback receives deep copies of allowlisted task/problem fields; exact JSON scoring needs no LLM judge. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-04-25 · [ProEval: Proactive Failure Discovery and Efficient Performance Estimation for Generative AI Evaluation](../../../foundation-models/2604.23099-proeval/README-en.md) (`proeval`): A target score enters the update only after its item is selected. Primary source: v1 §§2.1–2.4, Eqs. 2, 5, 7, 10, and 12. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.** [Method reference 1](<https://arxiv.org/html/2604.23099v1#S2>)
- 2025-02-20 · [SigLIP 2: Multilingual Vision-Language Encoders with Improved Semantic Understanding, Localization, and Dense Features](../../../reproductions/2502.14786-siglip2/README-en.md) (`siglip2`): SigLIP 2 extends SigLIP's pairwise sigmoid loss with captioning pretraining, global-local self-distillation, masked prediction, online data curation, and NaFlex dynamic resolution. This improves semantics, localization, dense features, and multilingual fairness.

## Google Research

- 2026-11-05 · [GINGER: Spicing Up Graph-Based Vector Search](../../../foundation-models/2611.08306-ginger/README-en.md) (`ginger`): The full library also builds graphs with PiPNN, reorders vertices so neighboring IDs are closer, compresses adjacency lists with AdaptiveGap, and uses PCA and candidate prefiltering to reduce search work. NTQ reduces bandwidth for vector representations. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10-19 · [DeepSEA: A Multilingual Evaluation Benchmark for Southeast Asia](../../../foundation-models/2610.26155-deepsea/README-en.md) (`deepsea`): Compare by resource tier and analyze English pivoting, errors and tokenizer efficiency. This is a benchmark, not a parameter update. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-06-02 · [Language Models Need Sleep: Learning to Self-Modify and Consolidate Memories](../../../foundation-models/2606.03979-sleep-lti/README-en.md) (`sleep-lti`): Knowledge seeding combines teacher data and distillation on student-generated prefixes. LTI has the student complete teacher dreams and rewards a frozen semantic judgment and thresholded token edit similarity. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-04-30 · [Optimized Deferral for Imbalanced Settings](../../../foundation-models/2604.27723-mild/README-en.md) (`mild`): The local code implements the logistic surrogate, analytical gradient, and bounded linear-router training. Inference accepts only features and trained parameters, not answers or actual expert costs. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.** [Method reference 1](<https://arxiv.org/html/2604.27723v1#S5.SS3>)
- 2026-02-19 · [A Theoretical Framework for Modular Learning of Robust Generative Models](../../../foundation-models/2602.17554-modular-robust-generative/README-en.md) (`modular-robust-generative`): Noncausal teacher samples are also distilled into a causal router that reads only prefixes. See §§5.2, 6, and 7.3. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.** [Method reference 1](<https://arxiv.org/html/2602.17554v1#S5.SS2>)
- 2026-01-29 · [ECO: Quantized Training without Full-Precision Master Weights](../../../foundation-models/2601.22101-eco-optimizer/README-en.md) (`eco-optimizer`): ECO updates quantized weights directly and feeds requantization error into existing momentum, without master weights or a persistent error buffer. Adam uses an elementwise effective step size; reusing SGDM's scalar coefficient is incorrect. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2023-05-22 · [GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints](../../../reproductions/2305.13245-gqa/README-en.md) (`gqa`): Share fewer KV heads among more query heads, balancing MHA quality and MQA decoding bandwidth.
- 2022-11-30 · [Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding](../../../reproductions/2211.17192-speculative-decoding/README-en.md) (`speculative-decoding`): A smaller draft model proposes multiple tokens; the target verifies a whole block. On rejection, sample from the corrected residual distribution, preserving the target distribution.

## Hanyang University

- 2026-09-04 · [BeaconKV: Key-Value Cache Compression Guided by Beacon Queries for Efficient Large Reasoning Model Inference](../../../reproductions/2609.04971-beaconkv/README-en.md) (`beaconkv`): Representative queries vote on key importance while a recent window is always retained. Under cache budget, rank historical key $k_j$ by $I_j=\max_{b\in B}\langle b,k_j\rangle$.

## Harbin Institute of Technology

- 2026-10-14 · [Time-JEPA: Grounding Video World Models with Physical Time Series](../../../foundation-models/2610.23982-time-jepa/README-en.md) (`time-jepa`): During training, the same online encoder processes masked context and unmasked video separately. Evaluation removes the physical-state head and still takes video only. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## Harvard University

- 2026-10-15 · [AdaLoop: Thinking with the Vision Encoder](../../../foundation-models/2610.21323-adaloop-vision/README-en.md) (`adaloop-vision`): AdaLoop freezes pretrained visual weights, pools question tokens to modulate shared visual blocks, and repeatedly updates the visual state. The question can change how many passes the model uses rather than leaving all reasoning to the language decoder. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10-15 · [RoleQ: Role-Aligned Scales for Converting Language Models to Ternary](../../../foundation-models/2610.21808-roleq/README-en.md) (`roleq`): Full RoleQ-T additionally needs rotation, GPTQ, distillation, and an optional Fisher two-plane method. A standalone quantization function does not replace that pipeline. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf

- 2026-08-06 · [MACRO: Markov Chain Routing of Transformer Layers](../../../reproductions/2608.05872-macro/README-en.md) (`macro`): MACRO represents skips, repeats, and residual additions with a context-conditioned Markov policy. Feedback updates the routing distribution and top-k Viterbi decodes candidate programs without changing base-model weights.

## Huawei

- 2026-07-20 · [Convolution for Large Language Models](../../../reproductions/2607.18413-conv-llm/README-en.md) (`conv-llm`): The paper compares 17 convolution placements on a fixed Qwen3 backbone and selects depthwise 1D convolution with `kernel=3` after linear Q/K/V projection and before attention aggregation. A residual keeps the original projection; no normalization or activation is added, and additional parameters are below `0.01%`.

## Huawei ACS Lab

- 2026-07-23 · [Adaptive Depth Sparse Framework: Similarity-Driven Resource Allocation for Pre-Trained LLMs](../../../reproductions/2607.21291-adadsf/README-en.md) (`adadsf`): An MLP router sends only Top-K tokens through the original Transformer block; other tokens take a residual bypass. Hidden states and output distributions are aligned jointly.

## Huawei Noah's Ark Lab, Montreal Research Center

- 2026-09-28 · [Fractional State Space Transition for Long Sequence Modeling](../../../foundation-models/2609.36314-frac-ssm/README-en.md) (`frac-ssm`): Approximate fractional power-law memory with finitely many logarithmically spaced exponential modes, combining long-tailed memory with bounded recurrent state and parallel training.

## Huawei Technologies Canada

- 2026-08-05 · [DBLast: Dependent Block Drafting for Stochastic Speculative Decoding](../../../reproductions/2608.05448-dblast/README-en.md) (`dblast`): **Topic: Speculative decoding.** Parallel block drafters often assume positions are conditionally independent and struggle to match the joint distribution at high sampling entropy. DBLast uses a shared low-rank latent mixture to model cross-position dependence and trains for expected verification length.

## Huazhong University of Science and Technology

- 2026-08-21 · [RARE: Decoupling Representation Steering from Expert Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models](../../../reproductions/2608.21236-rare/README-en.md) (`rare`): RARE projects an arbitrary steering direction into the router's null space, then removes router-visible components introduced during propagation at later protected layers. This changes behavior representations without changing the original expert paths.

## Hugging Face

- 2025-04-07 · [SmolVLM: Redefining small and efficient multimodal models](../../../reproductions/2504.05299-smolvlm/README-en.md) (`smolvlm`): Move neighboring spatial tokens into channels with pixel shuffle, then project into LM space with an MLP. The paper also studies long contexts, image tiling, learned position tokens and data mixtures for 256M/500M/2.2B image/video models.

## Independent Researcher

- 2026-10-27 · [Folding Attention Biases into Keys Makes Compacted KV Caches Run on Standard Kernels](../../../foundation-models/2610.36520-fold-bias/README-en.md) (`fold-bias`): This is an approximation, not an exact replacement for all future queries: a dot product is linear in the query, so it cannot represent a nonzero constant over the entire query space. The fit constrains the mean projection to one on the calibration queries and limits its variation. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10-21 · [When Multiple Choices Are Correct: Asymmetric Probability Allocation in Jev and Other Decision Models](../../../system-one/2610.29217-jev-multicorrect/README-en.md) (`jev-multicorrect`): Distinguish normalized categorical shares from independently queried binary correctness probabilities; the former are not calibrated binary confidence. The paper studies Jev, Luna and Gemini. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## Independent Researcher, Chile

- 2026-10-15 · [Patch where the text is new: a compression view of where byte-level models should spend compute](../../../foundation-models/2610.22100-novelty-patching/README-en.md) (`novelty-patching`): It computes match labels offline and looks up only the two preceding bytes online. Sources are Section 3 for method, Sections 4–7 for results and negatives, Section 8 for limits, and Code and data. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## Independent researchers

- 2026-07-23 · [Anti-Periodic Positional Encoding: Möbius Boundary Conditions Make In-Context Retrieval Reliable](../../../reproductions/2607.21405-mobius-rope/README-en.md) (`mobius-rope`): The paper applies antiperiodic frequencies to some heads so the rotation across the full training window is always $-I$. Other heads retain standard RoPE for language modeling.
- 2026-07-23 · [Naju: A Native Discrete State-Space Model with Independent Retention and Writing for Long-Sequence Memory](../../../reproductions/2607.21000-naju/README-en.md) (`naju`): A single coupled gate can also make strong retention incompatible with writing. Naju parameterizes discrete poles directly, separates retain and write gates, and keeps token-dependent $B/C$ directions, short-range causal convolution, direct feedthrough, and output modulation.

## Indian Institute of Technology Madras

- 2026-07-18 · [OpenLanguageModel: Readable and Composable Small-Language-Model Pretraining for Education and Research](../../../reproductions/2607.16669-open-language-model/README-en.md) (`open-language-model`): OLM keeps components as ordinary PyTorch modules and expresses wiring with Block, Residual, Repeat, and Parallel. The same model can move from a notebook to CPU, one GPU, or multiple GPUs on one host.

## Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee

- 2026-08-05 · [QEvict: Recoverable Quantized KV Eviction for Attention-Drift-Robust Long-Context Decoding](../../../reproductions/2608.05326-qevict/README-en.md) (`qevict`): **Topic: Long-context KV cache.** Binary keep/drop cannot handle attention drift: a low-priority window can later become relevant. QEvict uses full-precision, quantized-recoverable and deleted tiers, and dequantizes and promotes windows as accumulated attention changes.

## Inria

- 2026-10-16 · [BMuon: Budgeting Muon's Spectral Geometry for Structured Compressibility](../../../foundation-models/2610.23571-bmuon/README-en.md) (`bmuon`): Muon's spectral-norm update need not produce weights that are easy to prune by hidden channel. BMuon neither adds a forward-pass gate nor merely prunes a pretrained Muon model. **Hidden channels from all MLP blocks share one allocation budget**, and the update geometry changes jointly on the input-row and output-column sides of each channel. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

- 2026-10-25 · [ResCom: Activation Residual Compensation for Large Language Model Quantization](../../../foundation-models/2610.35955-rescom/README-en.md) (`rescom`): Ranking channels by residual magnitude is not equivalent: even a small residual can be amplified by the main projection. ResCom uses cross-statistics of residuals and output errors to allocate its rank budget for output reconstruction. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

- 2026-09-29 · [SPLASH: Switching Parallel Layouts of Attention with Seamless Handoff for LLM Serving](../../../foundation-models/2609.37626-splash/README-en.md) (`splash`): Unify attention-weight and KV-cache ownership. DOP shards weights while giving requests exclusive KV; schedule among TP, DP, CP, and DOP online, amortizing transition cost over remaining steps.
- 2026-08-07 · [Autonomy-of-Heads: Data-Free Sparse Attention from Frozen Query-Key Geometry](../../../reproductions/2608.06849-autonomy-heads/README-en.md) (`autonomy-heads`): Classify retrieval and streaming heads from the spectral effective rank of frozen QK projections, without calibration data or runtime gating.

- 2026-09-28 · [MS-GLA: Multi-Scale Gated Linear Attention for Addressing Representational Bottlenecks via Multi-Temporal Resolution](../../../foundation-models/2609.35664-ms-gla/README-en.md) (`ms-gla`): One time resolution can bottleneck linear attention.
